description: Find a movie or TV show from its name, a remembered fragment or a typo. Resolve its exact version before recommendations or availability checks. Returns canonical IDs and rich title context: description, genres, subgenres, tags, subjects, keywords, cast, directors, language, runtime and viewing_experience mood levels with scope and evidence labels. Choices cover viewer-mentioned titles or assistant-chosen mood references.

query.description: Movie or show name, including a remembered fragment or typo. Put an explicitly requested release year in year. Returns choices with exact IDs; never guess an ID.
query.title: Query

year.description: Exact original release year when the viewer specifies a version. For a series, its first-release year, not a season year.
year.title: Year

name: search_titles
title: Find a movie or show
